preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_configuration WHERE name = 'provisioning-catch-all-category-id'

changeSet.comment: Optional fallback provisioning category when loan DIA matches no bucket (enable and set value to m_provision_category.id)

column.name: description
column.value: When enabled, value holds m_provision_category.id whose criteria-definition row is used when DIA matches no configured range.

changeSet.author: felixm@inkomoko.com

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Provisioning By Category (Latest Run)'

changeSet.comment: Aggregates m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry for the latest provisioning history id, grouped by category / currency.

insert.column: SELECT DATE(ph.created_date) AS run_date, o.name AS office_name, COALESCE(pc.category_code, '-') AS category_code, COALESCE(pc.category_name, e.classification_type) AS category_label, e.currency_code, SUM(e.reseve_amount) AS total_reserved_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM m_provisioning_history ph JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry e ON e.history_id = ph.id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = e.office_id LEFT JOIN m_provision_category pc ON pc.id = e.category_id WHERE ph.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM m_provisioning_history) AND o.id = ${officeId} GROUP BY run_date, office_name, category_code, category_label, e.currency_code ORDER BY office_name, category_code

column.name: description
column.value: Latest provisioning run: reserved amounts by provisioning category and currency (office scope).

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report_parameter srp JOIN stretchy_report sr ON sr.id = srp.report_id WHERE sr.report_name = 'Provisioning By Category (Latest Run)'

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT sr.id FROM stretchy_report sr WHERE sr.report_name = 'Provisioning By Category (Latest Run)')

column.name: parameter_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT sp.id FROM stretchy_parameter sp WHERE sp.parameter_name = 'OfficeIdSelectOne')
